Renew Vehicle Registration
There are multiple options to renew your registration.
ONLINE - you will need:
Your current registration or the registration renewal notice
Checking account information or a MasterCard or Visa Credit card
Click here for online renewal
MAIL - you will need:
Registration renewal notice
Check or money order for exact amount
Proof of Insurance for the vehicle you are registering
Mail to: Sarpy County Treasurer, 1102 E 1st St, Papillion NE 68046
IN PERSON - you will need:
Cash, Credit/debit card or a check or money order for exact amount
Your current registration or the registration renewal notice
Proof of insurance for the vehicle you are registering
SECURE DROP BOX (located outside of the east entrance of the 1102 Building) - you will need:
Registration renewal notice
Check or money order for exact amount
Proof of Insurance for the vehicle you are registering
Nebraska Drivers can now receive Text and Email notifications for Vehicle Renewals. Click here for more information
FEES FOR DEBIT/CREDIT CARDS
Online Renewal - Debit/credit card 2.5% of total / Electronic Check $3.00
In-person - Debit $2.95 / Credit 2.5 % of total
Register New Vehicle
To register your vehicle after a purchase you will need the following:
The Certificate of Title or MSO (Manufacture Statement of Origin)
A completed Application for Certificate of Title signed by all parties whose names will appear on the title. The only exception are titles in the names of both spouses
If purchased from a Nebraska dealer a Nebraska Sales and Use Tax, Form 6 is required (Sales and Use Tax is required to be paid within 30 days of purchase to avoid late fees); OR if purchased from an Out-of-State Dealer a Purchase Agreement is required; OR if purchased from Private Sale you will need a Bill of Sale
If you have a loan on the vehicle, we must have a signed copy of your security agreement.
Proof of insurance
NOTE: If you purchased a vehicle with an out-of-state title it will require a VIN inspection. Exceptions: 1) Travel trailers and personal watercraft (boats, jet skis) do not require an inspection. 2) Utility trailers under 9,000 pounds do not require an inspection if you do not want to title it. However, If you do want to title a utility trailer, it will require an inspection, regardless of weight. Please call our office if you have questions.
The Sarpy County Sheriff's Vehicle Inspection office is located at 1102 E. 1st Street, Papillion, NE, hours are 8:00am. to 4:30pm., Monday through Friday. The fee for the Inspection is $10.00
Titles
A Certificate of Title is required for all types of vehicles driven or moved on the highways and roads of the State of Nebraska unless the vehicle falls under the specific category of Motor Vehicles Exempt from Titling .
To obtain a Certificate of Title, submit a completed Application for Certificate of Title (PDF) signed by all parties whose names are to appear on the title. The only exception to this are titles held by spouses, in which case either one, acting as an agent for the other, may sign the application. The fee for a Certificate of Title is $10; or $17 to notate a lien holder (a signed security agreement is required.)
NOTE: If you purchased a vehicle with an out-of-state title it will require a VIN inspection. Exceptions: 1) Travel trailers and personal watercraft (boats, jet skis) do not require an inspection. 2) Utility trailers under 9,000 pounds do not require an inspection if you do not want to title it. However, If you do want to title a utility trailer, it will require an inspection, regardless of weight. Please call our office if you have questions.
The Sarpy County Sheriff's Vehicle Inspection office is located at 1102 E. 1st Street, Papillion, NE, hours are 8:00am. to 4:30pm., Monday through Friday. The fee for the Inspection is $10.00
